chapter: Second lining and the brass bands
title: First band remembered: the Tuxedo and its successors
summary: The first band he remembers hearing was the Tuxedo, followed by other bands; he followed them all, including to white dances.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What was the first band you ever heard in person that you remember?
The Tuxedas was the oldest one you can remember?

The Tuxedas was the first one. Then come, the Tuxedas was the first, then come the Shatter Band, the O'Rica. Then after, they come, them little small, you know them little small drummers, you understand? But now all them, like all them big ones, all them, that's where they come from, them small ones. I used to be behind them all. And I don't care where they go, don't care where they went, I had to be with them. Sometimes if we play outside, if they play for, you know what I mean, for y'all. They say, Horace, I say, what? We playing for a white dance tonight. I say, all right. They say, you want, you can't? I say, it's okay with me.
You want something? I say, no, I don't want nothing.
